# CiteFlow AI Visibility Platform

CiteFlow helps websites optimize their structure and content for Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative Search Engines.

## Core Features
- AI Visibility Scoring
- FAQ Schema Generation
- Semantic Entity Mapping
- LLM Training Data Optimization
